title: Drawry 최종 앱 아이콘 · 리넨 스케치북

reference.description: 흰 배경, 자연색 풍경 사진과 검정 붓선이 있는 스케치북 시안을 편집. 중간 색상 시안은 최종 정리 시 제거.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one standalone Drawry app icon color sample matched to the app's approved default LINEN UI theme.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a pink sketchbook on white, with a blue-sky green-mountain photo and a black looping brushstroke.

Change ONLY the sketchbook COVER color to the app's existing light-theme surfaceSoft token #EEE2D9: a soft muted warm linen / light warm greige paper color. Match this color as the cover's base material, with realistic highlights and slightly deeper warm-neutral shading along the existing cover edges. It should read as an elegant natural paperboard artist's sketchbook, clearly distinguishable from the pure white surrounding background, white rings and white photo frame. Retain the subtle matte paper texture. No pink cast; no yellow cream, dark brown kraft, orange terracotta or green cover.

Preserve all existing geometry and content faithfully: exact notebook silhouette, size, position, square framing and margins; exactly TWO WHITE binding rings on the left; WHITE page stack on the right; WHITE inset photo border; the SAME blue sky, white clouds, green mountains and forest in the photograph; the BLACK dry-brush looping stroke's path, endpoints, thickness, texture and placement. Do not recolor the photo or black stroke. Preserve subtle neutral-gray cast shadows and the visible cover/page thickness.

The outer background remains clean opaque WHITE (#FFFFFF). Change the cover only, using #EEE2D9 as the paper color direction. No new accents, decorative elements, extra rings, text, logos, watermark, comparison grid or device mockup. One square image only.
paletteNotes: 표지는 앱의 surfaceSoft #EEE2D9를 제작 기준으로 사용. 하늘·산·붓선의 가이드 색상은 승인 이미지의 대표색이며 사진 전체를 단색으로 재칠하지 않는다.
